scope: Host-only protocol workload model; one physical assembly, not unseen-device qualification

reused_training_evidence.reason: Unchanged raw telemetry and experiments reused from complete training families. Only the invalid FIFO-consumption label proxy was removed; the OLED reads the latest-sample cache.

limitations: One assembly and twelve workload conditions do not establish accuracy on unseen peripherals or boards.
Only two held-out test families; no hyperparameter tuning after viewing those outcomes.
Configured rates and speeds are not measured CPU execution time or bus utilization.
SPI is a configured workload; the OLED reads the latest-sample cache, so FIFO consumption is not a completion metric.
UART freshness measures report transport, not occupancy detection accuracy.
Unknown workload contexts retain normal configuration and abstain from model advice.
The new 18-input model has no firmware/C export integration or resource qualification.
The 800 ms freshness goal is illustrative; finite polling can miss intermediate peaks.
